'''Johnny Marion''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[March 2001 Phoenix tournament (16 March)]] on 16 March 2001, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1925">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-viper-returns-phoenix-az-3-16-01d1925/ viper-returns-phoenix-az-3-16-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 20 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-viper-returns-phoenix-az-3-16-01d1925/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
